description: This file defines the TalkSystemSpeechSynthesizer class, a Swift implementation for text-to-speech synthesis using AVFoundation. It manages speech synthesis, including timeout handling, cancellation, and delegate callbacks.

classes.name: TalkSystemSpeechSynthesizer
classes.description: A class that manages speech synthesis, including starting, stopping, timeout handling, and delegate callbacks for speech events.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops ongoing speech and cancels related tasks.

methods.name: speak
methods.description: Performs speech synthesis for the given text with optional language and start callback, with timeout handling.

methods.name: watchdogTimeoutSeconds
methods.description: Calculates a timeout duration based on text length and language, estimating speech duration.

methods.name: matchesCurrentUtterance
methods.description: Checks if the given utterance ID matches the current utterance.

methods.name: handleFinish
methods.description: Handles completion or cancellation of speech, cancelling watchdog and finalizing continuation.

methods.name: finishCurrent
methods.description: Resets current utterance and continuation, and resumes the awaiting task with success or error.
